title: Lacson urges Marcos to reassess economic team amid ‘malaise’
summary: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Panfilo “Ping” Lacson on Wednesday urged President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. to take a closer look at his economic team, citing what he described as an “economic malaise.”…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Panfilo “Ping” Lacson on Wednesday urged President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. to take a closer look at his economic team, citing what he described as an “economic malaise.” Lacson raised concerns about several sectors of the economy, including the property and agriculture industries, as well as the country’s ability to attract investments.
